name: 73110 · Midwest City, OK
findings: ZIP 73110 (Midwest City) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73110 (Midwest City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73110 (Midwest City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
